storefront.heroTagline: Made by hand, one piece at a time
storefront.preorderCartNotice: Your cart has a preorder item. It will ship once it's ready, and we'll contact you with the date.
storefront.step1Body: Browse the collection and pick what fits your story.
storefront.step2Body: Send your details. No online payment needed.
storefront.step3Title: We bring it to your door
storefront.step3Body: We confirm your order and deliver it to you.
storefront.comingSoonNote: This product isn't available to order yet.
storefront.crossedMade: A crossed-out colour is out of stock: you can still order it and it will be made for you.
storefront.crossedSoldOut: A crossed-out colour is out of stock.
storefront.partlyMadeToOrder: Only {{n}} in stock. If you order more, this item will be made to order (it takes longer).
storefront.qtyPricesHint: The price of each piece drops as you add more. All colours and choices of this product count together.
storefront.qtyInCart: You already have {{n}} of this product in your cart. They count too.
storefront.minOrderNote: Minimum order: {{n}} pieces of this product.
storefront.minNotInStock: This product is sold from {{n}} pieces, and there is not enough in stock right now.

checkout.title: Checkout
checkout.name: Full name
checkout.orderPlacedBody: We've received your order and will contact you shortly to confirm delivery.
checkout.preorderPlacedBody: This is a preorder. We'll contact you to confirm the shipping date.

pnl.title: Profit & Loss
pnl.openOrdersNote: Not counted as profit until they are delivered.
pnl.missingCost: {{n}} delivered order(s) have no cost recorded, so profit may look higher than it really is. Add a cost price to your products.
pnl.note: Revenue counts delivered orders only. Expenses come from the Expenses screen.
pnl.courierNote: Courier fees come from the courier chosen on each order. Do not also add the same delivery cost as a "Shipping" expense, or it is counted twice.

login.resetSent: If this email has an account, we've sent a link to reset the password.

signup.title: Create your shop
signup.intro: This sets up your storefront and your partner login in one step.
signup.taken: The shop name "{{name}}" is already taken. Try a more specific name.
signup.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
signup.weakPassword: Password should be at least 6 characters.
signup.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
signup.network: Network error — please check your connection and try again.
signup.generic: Something went wrong creating your shop. Please try again.
signup.closed: Creating new shops is closed for now.

landing.body: Build a simple storefront and mini business dashboard for your handmade or small-batch product — no coding needed.

dash.lowStock: ⚠ {{n}} product(s) low or out of stock — review Products
dash.productsDesc: Add, edit, and manage what's for sale.
dash.expensesDesc: Log costs like materials and shipping.
dash.pnlDesc: Sales, cost and profit at a glance.
dash.settingsDesc: Colors, logo and the home page banner.
dash.promosDesc: Create discount codes for your customers.
dash.activityDesc: See who changed what, and when.
dash.teamDesc: Give each person their own login and role.
dash.couriersDesc: Delivery people, their fees and the cash they owe you.

products.costHint: Private: what one unit costs you. Customers never see this.
products.preorderCheck: This is a preorder product (customers can order it even when stock is 0)
products.badCost: Enter a valid cost price (or leave it empty).
products.saveFailed: Could not save the product. Please try again.
products.confirmDelete: Remove this product? It will disappear from the storefront but past orders stay intact.
products.lowBanner: {{n}} product(s) low or out of stock — check the badges below.
products.none: No products yet. Add your first one above.
products.shippingExtraHint: Added to the shipping fee for each unit of this product (for big or heavy items).
products.galleryHelp: Extra photos shown as small pictures under the main one. A color or choice can also have its own picture (in Options): the big picture changes when the customer picks it.
products.relatedHelp: Shown on this product's page as "Extensions and accessories". Each one is still a normal product that can be bought on its own.
products.stockHint: To change stock, use "Add stock" or "Adjust" on the product card. This keeps the stock history correct.
products.comingSoonCheck: Coming soon: show it in the shop, but don't allow orders yet
products.sellModeTitle: How do you sell this product?
products.sellStock: From stock: I count how many I have, and customers can only order what is left
products.sellMade: Made to order / pre-order only: no counting, always orderable
products.sellStockThenMade: From stock first, then made to order when the stock runs out
products.countHelp: Each value (for example each colour) gets its own number. Customers must choose it. A sold-out choice cannot be ordered (or is made to order if you picked the third way above).
products.countWarn: Counting by option starts every number at 0 and replaces the single stock number ({{n}}). After saving, use "Add stock" for each colour.
products.countedStockHint: Use "Add stock" and "Adjust" on the product card to change these numbers (you choose which colour).
products.qtyPricesHelp: Lower the price when a customer buys more. Example: normal price 100, from 5 pieces 90 each, from 10 pieces 85 each. All colours and choices of this product count together. What a choice adds (like a plate) is added on top, per piece.
products.limitsHelp: Leave a box empty for no limit of your own. One order never has more than {{max}} pieces of one product, and counted stock limits it too.
products.limitsErr: The minimum must be a whole number of 2 or more, the maximum a whole number of 1 or more, and the maximum cannot be below the minimum.
products.tierErr_incomplete: Fill in both boxes (from and price) of each quantity price, or remove the row.
products.tierErr_qty: "From" must be a whole number of 2 or more.
products.tierErr_price: Each price must be lower than the step before it (the first one lower than the normal price).
products.tierErr_order: Two price steps start at the same quantity. Use a different quantity for each.
products.tierErr_many: Too many quantity prices (6 at most).

orders.noCostRecorded: No cost was recorded for this order.
orders.confirmCancel: Cancel this order? Stock for its items will be restored automatically.

err.ALREADY_DELIVERED: This order was already delivered and cannot be cancelled.
err.NOT_RETURNABLE: Only a shipped or delivered order can be returned.

orders.returnHelp: Use this when the customer refused the parcel, delivery failed, or it was sent back. Choose what happens to the items.
orders.returnRestock: Returned: put items back in stock
orders.returnFailed: Could not mark this order as returned.
orders.noCouriersYet: No couriers yet. Add one in the Couriers page.

expenses.saveFailed: Could not save the expense. Please try again.

settingsPage.accentHelp: Used for buttons, highlights and links on your shop. The shop is always dark; only this color changes.
settingsPage.logoHelp: Paste a link to your logo image (a transparent PNG or SVG works best). Until you add one, the shop name is shown as text.
settingsPage.bannerHelp: The big picture at the top of your shop. Add one slide for a still banner, or up to {{max}} for a slideshow that changes by itself. Change the pictures here whenever you like. If you add none, the first product photo is used.
settingsPage.timingNote: Only used when you have 2 or more slides.
settingsPage.saved: Saved. Open your storefront to see the changes.
settingsPage.errHttps: Image links must start with https://
settingsPage.errSave: Could not save. Please try again.
settingsPage.checkoutHelp: Choose which details you ask customers for. Name and phone are always required because you need them to deliver.
settingsPage.shippingHelp: Add the places you deliver to and the price for each. Customers choose their area at checkout. If you add no zones, shipping is free and no area is asked.
settingsPage.errZone: Every zone needs a name and a price.
settingsPage.customHelp: Add your own questions (for example a gift message or a preferred delivery time). They appear at the end of the checkout form, in this order.
settingsPage.optionsLabel: Options (one per line, add the Arabic after |)
settingsPage.errCustom: Every extra field needs a label, and a drop-down list needs at least one option.
settingsPage.alertsHelp: Get a Telegram message the moment an order arrives. It is free and instant, and the whole team can be in one group.
settingsPage.alertsSteps: Add your order bot to your team's Telegram group (or send the bot a message), press “Find my chat” and pick it, then press “Send a test message”. Don't forget to save.
settingsPage.noChats: No chat found yet. Add the bot to your group, write a message there, then try again.
settingsPage.alertTestFail: Could not send. Check the chat ID, and that the bot is in the group.
settingsPage.alertNotConfigured: Alerts aren't switched on for this site yet (the bot key is missing).
settingsPage.phoneCodeHint: Egypt is 20. Local numbers like 010... get this code added in front.
settingsPage.autoplay: Change pictures automatically (visitors can always use the arrows or swipe)
settingsPage.backupHelp: Download all your shop data (products, orders, expenses, promo codes, settings) as one file. The free Firebase plan has no automatic backup, so do this every week and keep the file somewhere safe (for example Google Drive). It includes your private cost prices, so don't share it.
settingsPage.backupDone: Backup downloaded. Keep the file somewhere safe.
settingsPage.backupFailed: Could not create the backup. Please try again.
settingsPage.previewNote: Preview only. Nothing is saved until you press Save settings.
settingsPage.logoDarkHelp: Optional: a second logo that is shown instead of the main one when the shop is dark. Use a version that is clearly visible on a dark background (a transparent PNG works best). If you leave it empty, the main logo is used everywhere.
settingsPage.heroStyle_card_help: The text sits in a dark card, with your highlights as ticks under the button.
settingsPage.heroStyle_plain_help: The text sits directly on the picture (the older look).
settingsPage.highlightsHelp: Up to {{max}} short promises about your shop (for example quality, returns, support). The titles appear as ticks on the banner, and as cards under it. Write only what is true for your shop.
settingsPage.pagesHelp: Write each page in your own words (plain text; a blank line starts a new paragraph). A page appears in the shop footer only when it has text. Please make sure the text follows the rules of your country.
settingsPage.promoQtyLabel: Promo codes also apply to items that have a quantity price
settingsPage.promoQtyHelp: On: a code takes its discount from the whole order. Off: a code only takes its discount from items without a quantity price, and cannot be used when every item has one.

errors.generic: Something went wrong placing your order. Please try again.
errors.fillAll: Please fill in your name, phone, and address.
errors.BAD_PHONE: Please enter a valid phone number.
errors.BAD_ITEM: Something in your cart is invalid. Please review it.
errors.TOO_MANY: You can order up to {{max}} pieces of one product.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: Sorry, one of the items in your cart is no longer available.
errors.OUT_OF_STOCK_PARTIAL: Sorry, only {{stock}} of "{{name}}" left in stock.
errors.BAD_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.BAD_ZONE: This delivery area is not available. Please choose another.
errors.PROMO_LIMIT: This promo code has reached its usage limit.
errors.PROMO_MIN_ORDER: This code needs an order of at least {{min}}.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts from this phone number or connection. Please try again later, or contact us directly.
errors.TRACK_NOT_FOUND: We could not find an order with these details. Please check the order number and the phone number you used when ordering.
errors.PROMO_NOT_ON_QTY: This code can't be used on items that already have a quantity price.

promos.title: Promo codes
promos.help: Create discount codes. Customers type a code at checkout and see the discount before they order. You can turn a code off at any time.
promos.badCode: Enter a valid code (2–30 letters, numbers, - or _).
promos.badValue: Enter a valid value (a percentage can't be above 100).
promos.badMin: Enter a valid minimum order (or leave it empty).
promos.badLimit: The usage limit must be at least 1 (or leave it empty).
promos.saveFailed: Could not save the code. Please try again.

upload.failed: Upload failed. Try again or paste a link.
upload.tooBig: This picture is too large (the limit is 8 MB).
upload.notSetUp: Picture upload isn't switched on yet. Paste a picture link instead.

options.title: Options (colors, activity, extensions...)
options.help: Let customers customize the product. Each choice can change the price. Stock is shared by all choices, so use "Preorder" for made-to-order products.
options.costHint: Costs are private: customers never see them. They are used for your profit report.
options.errInvalid: Every option needs a name, and a color or choice list needs at least one named choice.
options.valueImage: Picture for this choice (optional): the product photo changes to it when picked
options.askText: Ask the customer to type a word or comment when this box is ticked
options.textRequired: The customer must type something when ticked

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.body: The page didn't load properly. Please try again.

team.title: Team
team.help: Give each person their own email and password, and choose what they can do. Nobody shares a login. A shop can have several owners (partners).
team.blocked: This account has been switched off. Please contact the shop owner.
team.noAccess: Your role doesn't have access to this page.
team.roleHelp_owner: everything, including the team and the shop settings
team.roleHelp_manager: products, orders, expenses, promo codes and reports
team.roleHelp_staff: orders only (move them along, fix customer details)
team.confirmOff: Switch off {{name}}? They will be signed out and won't be able to log in.
team.linkHelp: Send this link to {{name}}. It lets them choose their own password. Only they should receive it.
team.shareMessage: Hello {{name}}, you've been added to the {{shop}} admin. Open this link to choose your password, then sign in with your email: {{link}}
team.name: Name

err.BAD_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
err.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email already belongs to another shop.
err.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already on your team.
err.CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF: You can't change your own account here.
err.FORBIDDEN: Only the owner can manage the team.
err.AUTH_PERMISSION: The server isn't allowed to create logins yet. Add the role "Firebase Authentication Admin" to its Google account (see the setup steps).
err.SERVER: Something went wrong. Please try again.

team.ownersNote: Owners can do everything, including adding or removing other owners and changing the shop settings. Give this role only to partners you fully trust. Every change is recorded in the activity log.
team.confirmOwnerChange: {{name}} is an owner (a partner). Change their access? This is recorded in the activity log.

audit.title: Activity log
audit.help: Who changed what, and when. Entries can't be edited or deleted.
audit.loadFailed: Could not load the activity log.

action.order.customer: edited the customer details of order

field.name: Name
field.backorder: Stock first, then made to order

stats.valueNote: * Some products with stock have no cost price yet, so the value is incomplete.
stats.backupNever: You haven't downloaded a backup yet. Please download one now, then every week.
stats.backupDue: It's been {{days}} days since your last backup.

stock.title: Stock history
stock.help: Every change of stock: what happened, how many, who and when. Lines can't be edited or deleted.
stock.quantity: How many units are you adding?
stock.totalCost: Total cost of this batch (EGP, optional)
stock.totalCostHint: What the whole batch cost you: materials, printing, labour. Leave empty if you don't know.
stock.updateCost: Update the product's cost price (average of old and new stock)
stock.recordExpense: Also record this amount as an expense
stock.countLabel: Real number on the shelf now
stock.removeLabel: How many are damaged or lost?
stock.previewUnit: Cost per unit of this batch: {{unit}}
stock.loadFailed: Could not load the stock history.

err.BAD_QUANTITY: Enter a whole number of units (1 or more; a stocktake can be 0).
err.BAD_COST: Enter a valid cost (0 or more).
err.NO_CHANGE: That is already the current stock.
err.TOO_MANY: You can't remove more than what is in stock.
err.BAD_MODE: Choose what you want to do.
err.SERVER: Could not save. Please try again.
err.NEED_OPTION: Please choose which colour / option this is for.

appearance.modeHelp: Choose how the shop looks by default. Visitors can always switch with the sun / moon button, and their choice is remembered on their phone.
appearance.accentHelp: Used for buttons, highlights and links. Pick a ready color or any color you like. The text on it is adjusted automatically, so it stays easy to read in light and dark.
appearance.readableNote: Text on the color, and links, are adjusted automatically to stay readable.
appearance.faintLight: This color is very close to a light page, so buttons may be hard to see in light mode. Try a stronger color.
appearance.faintDark: This color is very close to a dark page, so buttons may be hard to see in dark mode. Try a brighter color.
appearance.faintBoth: This color is very close to both light and dark pages, so buttons may be hard to see. Try a stronger color.
appearance.fontHelp: The font of titles and big headlines. Only the font you choose is downloaded by visitors.
appearance.barHelp: A thin colored bar at the very top of your shop. Good for an offer or delivery news.
appearance.barLinkHint: A full https:// address, or #products to scroll down to the products.
appearance.barMoreHelp: Up to {{max}} more messages. With several, the bar changes message by itself and shows arrows.

contact.title: Contact and social
contact.help: Shown in the footer of your shop. Only what you fill in is shown.
contact.floating: Show a round WhatsApp button on every page of the shop
contact.floatingHint: Customers can message you in one tap. It uses the WhatsApp number above.

track.title: Track my order
track.intro: Enter your order number and the phone number you used when ordering to see where your order is.
track.phone: Phone number used on the order
track.privacyNote: We ask for your phone number only to make sure the order is yours. You will see the status and dates only.
track.fillBoth: Please enter the order number and the phone number.
track.preorderNote: This is a pre-order or made-to-order item, so it can take longer to be ready.

desc.pending: We received your order and will confirm it soon.
desc.shipped: Your order has been handed over for delivery.
desc.delivered: Your order was delivered. Thank you!
desc.cancelled: This order was cancelled. Please contact us if you have questions.
desc.returned: This order was returned. Please contact us if you have questions.

couriers.title: Couriers
couriers.intro: The delivery companies and people who deliver your orders. Set what each one charges per area, pick one on each order, and see how much cash they owe you.
couriers.name: Name
couriers.collectsCash: This courier collects the cash from the customer
couriers.collectsCashHelp: Switch off when the shop collects the money itself. The fee is still counted as owed to the courier.
couriers.feesHelp: What this courier charges for one delivered order, per area. Leave an area empty to use the "other areas" fee.
couriers.noZones: Add delivery areas in Settings to set a different fee for each area.
couriers.returnPercent: Fee when an order is returned (%)
couriers.returnPercentHelp: 100 = the full fee, 0 = no fee. Cancelled orders never cost a fee.
couriers.none: No couriers yet. Add the first one.
couriers.hHelp: A saved handover cannot be edited. If you made a mistake, save a new one in the opposite direction.
couriers.errFee: Fees must be numbers, 0 or more.
couriers.errPercent: The return percentage must be between 0 and 100.
couriers.errSave: Could not save. Please try again.
couriers.dayHelp: Pick a day to see, for each courier, the orders delivered or returned that day, the cash collected and the fees earned.
couriers.dayNone: No delivered or returned orders, and no handovers, on this day.
couriers.dayHandedIn: Cash handed to you that day
couriers.dayPaidOut: Paid to the courier that day
couriers.loadError: The couriers could not be loaded. This usually means the latest security rules have not been published in Firebase yet (Firestore Database > Rules). Publish them, then try again.
